title: decaloba bilobata
intro: Decaloba bilobata, commonly known as the bilobed calumba, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Decaloba bilobata include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include coumarins, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
